section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through the descent and investment of the hundred years (the general inclusive principle) into the intellect and emotions down to practical action, not only is the lower refined, but the higher itself is elevated, and ultimately, from the perspective of the intent of the Awtsmoos, upper and lower are truly equal.
section.t: Now,
through the drawing down and investment of the hundred years, the general inclusive principle of all, into the intellects that relate to the emotions
(twenty years)
and into the emotions
(seven years)
until the work in actual deed, in order that there be a revelation of G‑dliness in the world,
then there is also brought about
(in addition to the clarification and refinement of the lower)
a greater elevation in the aspect of the hundred years, the general inclusive principle of all,
as is known,
that through the descent of the higher to influence the lower, the higher also receives the virtue of the lower
(therefore the entire order of the chain of descent is in a manner that their beginning is embedded in their end,
that the higher also needs to receive from the lower).
And moreover,
since the drawing down below is because the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower realms,
therefore,
through the drawing down below, the intent of the Awtsmoos, which is above any attribute and limitation, is completed,
therefore,
upper and lower,
without limit and with limit,
are truly equal.
And the difference between these two modes in service,
is that in the first mode there is a distinction between the upper
(service in matters of holiness)
and the lower
(service in worldly matters),
and the service below is a matter of descent,
except that this descent is a necessary prerequisite for the ascent.
But in the second mode,
since his entire purpose is only to fulfill the desire and will of the Holy One, blessed be He, who desired to have a dwelling place in the lower realms,
therefore,
from the perspective of the intent of the Awtsmoos, there is no difference between the upper
(service in matters of holiness)
and the lower
(service in worldly matters),
and consequently,
the service below is not a matter of descent,
because the general point
(the general inclusive principle of all)
is felt in it, which is present in all matters of service in exactly the same way,
the intent of the Awtsmoos.
And this is also the secret of the hundred blessings each day,
as our Sages learned from the verse "What does the L‑rd your G‑d ask of you,"
do not read "Mah" (what) but "Me'ah" (hundred),
as explained in the discourses,
that "hundred" (me'ah) is "what" (mah) with the addition of the letter aleph,
"Mah" is the matter of self-nullification
("and we are nothing"),
and through the self-nullification of "Mah" they draw down the aleph,
the aspect of Kesser
(hundred),
that it be drawn down in revelation below through the blessings.
For since his service is from the aspect of self-nullification and acceptance of the yoke, in which the essence of the soul is revealed,
then his entire purpose is only to fulfill the will and desire of the Holy One, blessed be He,
which is the general point of all matters of service,
the intent of the Awtsmoos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The verse "And the life of Sarah was one hundred years and twenty years and seven years" teaches that all these categories of service are equal for good, because when service stems from the essence of the soul, all matters are equal in fulfilling the intent of the Awtsmoos.
section.t: Based on this, we can explain the statement "And the life of Sarah was one hundred years and twenty years and seven years, the years of the life of Sarah,"
that "the years of the life of Sarah"
(is not a separate matter above the three divisions of one hundred years, twenty years, and seven years,
but rather)
they are the very same 127 years,
that all of them are equal for good.
For,
at the beginning of the verse, the elevation that occurs in the hundred years through the drawing down below is explained,
which is the matter of "a hundred-year-old is like a twenty-year-old, and a twenty-year-old is like a seven-year-old,"
that in the hundred, the elevation of twenty is also added,
and in the twenty, the elevation of seven is also added.
Afterwards, the verse adds "the years of the life of Sarah,"
that all the types of service of one hundred years
(Kesser)
twenty years
(intellect)
and seven years
(emotions)
are equal for good,
that their entire purpose is to complete the intent of the Awtsmoos,
which is present in all matters of service equally.
And we should add in the explanation that "all of them are equal for good,"
that "good" alludes to the essence and source of good and the nature of good to do good,
as it is drawn down and revealed in the soul of each and every Jew, which is "literally a part of G‑d from above,"
a part of the essence, through which one grasps the essence,
and when the service is from the aspect of the essence of the soul,
which is the matter of self-nullification and acceptance of the yoke,
then all matters of service are equal,
and the equality is for good,
that all matters of service are permeated with the general point of drawing down and revealing the essence of good below,
to make a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: May it be His will that since in our days all service has been completed, we immediately merit the true and complete redemption, when the aspect of Yitzchak will be revealed, including the new Torah of our Rebbes, speedily and truly now.
section.t: May it be His will,
that since in these days of ours all our deeds and service in all the particular matters of one hundred years, twenty years, and seven years have been completed,
and in the manner of "the years of the life of Sarah" that all of them are equal for good,
as stated by his holy honor, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, the leader of our generation, that they have already polished the buttons,
and stand ready
to greet the face of our righteous Moshiach,
and especially since after this many more decades have passed in which the children of Israel have cried out "Until when?"
(which surely must also have a limit),
may the true and complete redemption come immediately and at once through our righteous Moshiach,
and then the matter of "the generations of Yitzchak" will be revealed
(as we begin to read in the Torah at Minchah),
as our Sages said,
that in the future, they will specifically say to Yitzchak "for you are our father,"
because the delight and laughter
(Yitzchak)
that was brought about through our deeds and service throughout the entire time of the exile
will be revealed in the future,
when
"our mouth will be filled with laughter,"
and then the matter of one hundred years, twenty years, and seven years will be in a more elevated manner,
both the matter of one hundred years,
one hundred blessings,
and the matter of 27 years,
which alludes
(also)
to the 27
letters of the Torah,
since all matters of Torah and mitzvos will be in ultimate perfection,
as "the mitzvos of Your will,"
and "a new Torah will go forth from Me,"
the reasons of the Torah that will be revealed in the future in the Torah of Moshiach,
including also the new Torah of our Nesi'im, up to the Baal HaYom HaHuledes of the 20th of MarCheshvan,
and his only son, his successor, his holy honor, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, the leader of our generation,
that "they will awaken and sing, those who dwell in the dust,"
and they, at their head,
will say new Torah,
a novelty even for the Holy One, blessed be He,
so to speak,
in the manner of our Sages' statement,
"My children have defeated Me, My children have defeated Me,"
up to "a new Torah will go forth from Me,"
"from Me"
specifically,
and in a manner that "they will no longer teach a man his fellow... for they will all know Me,"
"Me"
specifically,
and furthermore, and this is the main point,
that all this will be immediately and at once,
truly immediately.
